name: INABULETWO Reusable Pet Hair Removal Gloves (2 Pack)
description: INABULETWO 2-pack reusable pet hair removal grooming gloves. Powered by advanced static technology to effortlessly attract and lift cat and dog fur, lint, and dust in one swipe. Features a smart bidirectional bristle design that automatically gathers loose hair into easy-to-discard clumps. Soft, washable, and gentle on fabrics and skin. Great eco-friendly alternative to disposable sticky rollers for sofas, clothes, bedding, and car seats. Great condition, selling for cheap as part of a graduation yard sale!
name_zh: INABULETWO 双面静电吸毛宠物除毛手套 (两只装)
description_zh: INABULETWO 品牌双色便携宠物除毛粘毛手套（2只装）。采用物理静电原理，滑过织面即可快速吸附猫狗浮毛、衣物起球和灰尘。独特的双向密齿设计能在来回刷动的过程中将毛发自动聚拢成条，极易成块剥离清理。材质柔软可水洗，环保耐用。非常适合清理沙发、床单、大衣以及汽车座椅。状态良好，毕业清仓打包便宜卖！
